scope: Source and local genuine frozen-tail / synthetic-kernel / real-filesystem controls only. No production selection, service or callback-duration qualification.
verified: The fixture executes the frozen completion tail and reproduces its refusal after native-start acknowledgement, three health samples and boot publication; the new helper does not replay those actions.

Normalization is confined to the recorded ExecStart start-time and PID presentation clearing. Literal program/argv, ignore-error, stop, status/code and every other actor/unit/process/environment field must match, with separate current typed D-Bus command verification.

Original operation, completed native adoption prefix, owned start clock, matching original/own started actors, three original health samples, exact boot inode, loaded definitions and current private/source/READ/native-health checks remain mandatory.
Only new receipt files are written after identical live capture before and after durable intent. Foreign existing selection or competing inverse prefixes in either journal refuse.

Explicit finish authenticates the exact owned intent and current binding after an intent-only crash or a lost own acknowledgement; selected.json is created only when absent and is never overwritten. No start, stop, reload, database write or acceptance-sample replay occurs.

New completion proof authenticates its own producer and acknowledgement, current actor and original selected receipt. The original failed selection and parent completion remain historical failures, not success aliases.
Protected observation directories and exclusive durable writes keep detailed observations private; CLI output remains aggregate-only.
closedFindings: Observation-directory ownership/mode validation was missing for an existing directory.
Competing inverse prefixes also needed rejection in the parent completion journal.
Intent-only interruption initially had no explicit finish path.
